tools.name: lookup_ioc
tools.description:
Check whether one IOC (indicator of compromise) appears in Rösti's
threat-intelligence reports.

A defanged value (hxxps://evil[.]com, 1.2.3[.]4) is refanged before the
lookup; `input` then shows the value as given. Matching is exact, with a
case-insensitive fallback. Returns every report the value

tools.name: search_iocs
tools.description:
Search IOCs across all Rösti reports by text, type, tag, category and
creation time. Without filters, lists IOCs from all reports.

Each IOC carries its report id (use get_report for the report), type,
category, tags, IDS flag, comment and false-positive risk. Use lookup_ioc
or lookup_iocs to check

tools.name: search_reports
tools.description:
Search Rösti's threat-intelligence reports by text, source, CVE, MITRE
ATT&CK id and publication date.

Returns report summaries: title, date, source, authors, tags, counts of IOCs,
YARA rules and MITRE ids, and links to the original report and rosti.dev.
Use get_report for the details of one report

tools.name: get_report
tools.description:
Get one Rösti report: metadata, MITRE ATT&CK ids, CVEs, available export
formats, and how many of its IOCs there are per type and per tag.

Use list_report_iocs for the IOCs themselves and get_yara_rules for its
YARA rules.

tools.name: list_report_iocs
tools.description:
List the IOCs of one Rösti report, optionally filtered by type, tag,
category or text.

IOCs with the same entity_ref belong together, e.g. the MD5, SHA-1 and
SHA-256 of one file. Each IOC carries its IDS flag and false-positive risk.

tools.name: get_yara_rules
tools.description: Get the YARA rules published with one Rösti report, with their full source.

tools.name: find_related_reports
tools.description:
Find other Rösti reports that share IOCs with one report, most shared
IOCs first, with the shared values.

tools.name: get_export_link
tools.description:
Get a download link for one report export, e.g. CSV or MISP.

The link is signed and expires after 15 minutes; it is meant to be opened by
the user, not downloaded here.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description:
List the publishers whose reports Rösti collects (vendor blogs, CERTs,
researchers), with report counts, the newest report date and whether the
source is still active. Source ids work as the sources filter of
search_reports.

tools.name: describe_taxonomy
tools.description:
List the values Rösti uses for IOC types, IOC tags (with descriptions),
IOC categories and export formats, and explain the false-positive risk
scale. Use these values for the filters of the search and list tools.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_iocs, lookup_ioc, search_iocs · Private data: list_report_iocs · Public sink: find_related_reports.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_iocs, lookup_ioc, search_iocs · Private data: list_report_iocs · Public sink: find_related_reports

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_iocs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
